description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Pass the Story public_id or story link that eacc_get_hot_topics returned; never invent or infer IDs.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

public_id.description: Story public ID or story link, from eacc_get_hot_topics (Story public_id or links.story); never guess it.

report_limit.description: Maximum number of timeline reports, from 1 to 50.

name: eacc_get_story
